title: Database IDE - Core Application
description:
## Overview
Build a modern, GPUI-based database IDE for working with multiple database systems, starting with MongoDB support.

## Goals
- Create a sleek, dark-themed database management interface
- Support MongoDB connections with credential storage
- Provide query execution and data viewing capabilities
- Establish extensible architecture for additional database types

## Success Criteria
- [ ] User can create and save MongoDB connections
- [ ] Connection credentials persist in config file
- [ ] Query editor functional with result display
- [ ] Object viewer shows database structure
- [ ] Dark, modern UI with smooth performance

## Scope
**In Scope**: Core UI framework, MongoDB support, connection management, basic query execution
**Out of Scope**: Advanced features (migration tools, stored procedures), additional database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL)

title: rusty-data Data Access Library
description:
## Overview
Create a separate data library crate (rusty-data) with adapter pattern for multi-database support. Handles data access, configuration, and credential management for rusty-app.

## Goals
- Clean separation between UI (rusty-app) and data layer (rusty-data)
- Adapter pattern supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite
- Secure credential storage with encryption
- TOML-based configuration

## Success Criteria
- [ ] Workspace structure with rusty-data and rusty-app crates
- [ ] Core DatabaseAdapter trait with implementations
- [ ] TOML config with encrypted credentials working
- [ ] All three database adapters implemented
- [ ] rusty-app successfully using rusty-data

## Scope
**In Scope**: Workspace setup, adapter trait, config management, PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite adapters, integration
**Out of Scope**: MongoDB/Redis adapters (future), GUI for connection management, query builder

## Features
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Workspace Setup | Convert to workspace with rusty-data/rusty-app crates |
| Core Infrastructure | DatabaseAdapter trait, error types, core types |
| Configuration | TOML config loading, encrypted credential storage |
| Database Adapters | PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite implementations |
| Integration | Wire rusty-data into rusty-app |
